about: Client visual streaming: present on a loaded cluster while part of its content (added/changed entities) is being reloaded; holds the partial loading jobs. Written by ls::ClusterLoadHelper<ls::ClusterVisualLoaderSystem::LoadOps> (ProcessContentChanges, ProcessClusterLoadResult), ClusterVisualLoaderSystem::ApplyLoadResultToEntity / ProcessEntitiesToUnload / Update. Seen alive when the party split and on a raft event (content moved within loaded clusters).
